audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you twice to "save Thundering Blow to knock him out of his engage" and "hold Thundering Blow to knockback him out of his R engage". Unstoppable Force cannot be knocked out of. The mirror audit (audits/top/malphite__jayce.json, point 4) verified on the League Wiki that the dash is displacement-immune — it cannot be deterred by crowd control. Separately, the page attributes his shield to W five times ("his W shield", "burn his W shield"). Riot's text for Thunderclap is a sonic boom creating aftershocks; the shield is Granite Shield, the PASSIVE, absorbing up to 10% of his maximum Health and recharging only if he has not been hit for a few seconds.
audit.why: The knockback error is the expensive one: it spends a 20-second cooldown on an ability that does nothing, at the exact moment you most need peel, and it is the page's stated answer to the thing it calls a death sentence. Thundering Blow is worth spending BEFORE the cast, or afterwards to shove him back off you — never during. The shield error costs you a plan: because Granite Shield recharges only when he goes unhit, continuous gate-Q chip keeps it permanently down, whereas one big poke every ten seconds simply refills it. That is a wave-by-wave decision the page cannot express while it thinks the shield is on W.
audit.corrected: Thundering Blow re-tasked to before-the-cast and after-the-landing; the shield renamed Granite Shield with its 10% max-HP value and its recharge-on-not-being-hit condition.
sources: audits/top/malphite__jayce.json point 4 (League Wiki: Unstoppable Force dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control')

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says "respect his Unstoppable Force cooldown like a death timer" and never prints the timer. No cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s at 1000 range — that is over two minutes at rank 1, and it is the difference between a lane you cannot play and a lane where you have two full minutes of free shoving after he uses it. Seismic Shard at a flat 8s and Ground Slam at a flat 7s are the numbers that govern every step-up in between.
audit.corrected: Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s at 1000, Seismic Shard 8s, Ground Slam 7s and Thunderclap 10s written into the level-6 spike, mid and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ground Slam is never mentioned anywhere on the page, in either layer, and Seismic Shard is described only as "his Q-slow".
audit.why: Both are grounding abilities, and grounding is the one status that switches Jayce off: To the Skies! is a dash and Hextech Capacitor's move speed is your disengage, so a grounded Jayce cannot leap in or walk out. Ground Slam also reduces attack speed, which lands directly on Hyper Charge — the ability whose entire function is maximum attack speed for a few attacks. And Seismic Shard does not merely slow: it STEALS your move speed onto him, so the gap closes from both ends. None of those three facts are on the page.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam named with its 7s cooldown, its grounding and its attack-speed cut against Hyper Charge; Seismic Shard corrected from a slow to a move-speed steal that also grounds.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your window and you have to bank a lead here. Open in Cannon form and gate-Q his step-ups: fire Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate the instant he walks up to last-hit, then swap to Hammer for the armor/MR-shred first hit if he's in range. He barely cares about CS pressure — he'll soak poke behind his W shield and keep farming, so push for plates and a health lead rather than chasing a kill, because his W shield and incoming armor blunt your physical orb fast. Your edge that the raw armor doesn't answer is Hammer E's magic damage and the R-swap shred.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your window and you have to bank a lead here. Open in Cannon form and gate-Q his step-ups, then swap for the armor/MR-shred first hit if he's in range. The shield is Granite Shield, his passive — 10% of max HP, and it only recharges after he goes a few seconds unhit, so steady chip keeps it permanently spent while one orb every ten seconds just refills it. He barely cares about CS pressure, so push for plates rather than a kill. Your edge that raw armour never answers is Thundering Blow's magic damage and the swap shred.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where this slips toward him. His W shield and first armor purchase start eating the Cannon-Q that chunked him at level 2, and at 6 his R changes everything — Unstoppable Force is an un-dodgeable charge-knockup, and since you build zero defensive stats an R into ignite or a jungler is a clean kill on you. Remember your own R is just the Cannon/Hammer stance-swap (with the passive movespeed burst), not an escape ult, so respect his Unstoppable Force cooldown like a death timer: don't shove flat into him with no flash, and save Thundering Blow to knock him out of his engage or peel the dive.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 slip toward him. Granite Shield and his first armour buy start eating the Cannon-Q that chunked him at 2, and at 6 Unstoppable Force changes everything — 130s at rank 1, and the dash is displacement-immune, so Thundering Blow cannot knock him out of it. Spend the knockback before he casts or after he lands. Watch both his grounds too: Seismic Shard steals your move speed onto him and Ground Slam cuts your attack speed on a 7s timer, which is aimed squarely at Hyper Charge — and grounded, To the Skies! and your Capacitor escape are both gone.

edits.before: He soaks your poke behind the W shield and farms to his power spikes; his point-and-click R means he dictates when fights happen, not you.
edits.after: He soaks poke behind Granite Shield and farms to his spikes; a 130s displacement-immune R means he dictates when fights happen, not you.

notes: MIRROR: this matchup already had an audit from Malphite's side (audits/top/malphite__jayce.json) and I reused its findings rather than re-deriving them. It web-verified on the League Wiki that Unstoppable Force's dash cannot be deterred by crowd control. That kills the Jayce page's stated answer to level 6, which appears twice: "save Thundering Blow to knock him out of his engage" and "hold Thundering Blow to knockback him out of his R engage". A 20-second knockback spent mid-dash accomplishes nothing; it is worth spending before the cast or after he lands. ATTRIBUTION ERROR: the page says "his W shield" five times. Riot's text for Thunderclap is a sonic boom creating aftershocks — no shield. The shield is Granite Shield, the passive, worth 10% of his maximum Health and recharging only if he has not been hit for a few seconds. That condition is actionable and the page could not state it while it believed the shield was on W: steady chip keeps Granite Shield permanently spent, one big orb every ten seconds refills it. MISSING ENTIRELY: Ground Slam appears nowhere on the page in either layer. It grounds, it is a flat 7s, and it reduces attack speed — aimed straight at Hyper Charge, whose whole function is maximum attack speed. Seismic Shard also grounds and STEALS move speed onto him rather than merely slowing you. Grounding is the status that switches Jayce off entirely, since To the Skies! is a dash and Hextech Capacitor is the escape, and this was the most important absent interaction in the matchup. Cooldowns added: Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s at 1000 range, Seismic Shard 8s, Ground Slam 7s, Thunderclap 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. LEVEL CHART: the chart gave Jayce six of seven stages in a matchup he loses 46.4% over 3694 games, directly above prose reading "This is his half of the lane" and "the 46.4% win rate are his". The mirror audit identified the same problem and recorded that it could not propose the flip because 'Jayce' to 'Malphite' exceeds the length band on an enum field where the band has no meaning. I have proposed it here — first item and 2+ items to Malphite in both layers — so if the band rejects it, the same fix is now on record from both directions.
